tokens.v: Catch her at full stride toward the lens, jacket worn open over a plain white ribbed tank, both front panels swung back with the step, copper shank buttons catching in a line. 50mm at f/2 from chest height, tracking with her; her trailing hand and the swinging hem carry the only blur. Charcoal wide-leg trousers, white leather sneakers, fully dressed. A blurred pedestrian shoulder crosses the near-left edge; the shopfront behind dissolves to soft verticals. Her stride is long and mid-motion, the leading knee driving forward, hem and trailing hand carrying real blur. A small unlettered woven selvedge flag sits at the inner collar seam, flipped out by the wind.
